system energy ballooned by step 18 due to saturated controller work
one step before violation pole was still inside limit but deteriorating rapidly

counterfactual.change: set sensor_noise from 0.01838 to 0; same 18 steps, no pole_upright violation, proving noisy feedback caused destabilization

explanation: Seeded sensor noise (~0.018) corrupts angle/rate feedback to the state-feedback controller. Controller reacts to phantom errors with large saturated forces (67.78 N at steps 15,17,18), pumping energy (0.77J to 36.5J) and driving cart velocity to ~8 m/s and omega to ~-9.9 rad/s. Positive feedback diverges theta from -0.05 to -0.896 rad by step 18, violating pole_upright. Removing noise alone stabilizes the run.
vision_note: The cart drifts rightward across steps 15 to 18 while the pole leans increasingly to the left. By step 18 the lean is markedly larger and the tip turns red, marking the pole_upright violation.
